records.jp: やっぱり、これ作ってよかった
records.en_original: I'm glad we ended up making this fire.
records.en: I'm glad we ended up making this fire.

records.jp: 気分は味わえたし、かなり満足
records.en_original: It really captures the "camping" vibe.
records.en: It really captures the "camping" vibe.

records.jp: 私は、いろんなものを焼きたくなってくるなあ
records.en_original: I want to try roasting all kinds of things!
records.en: I want to try roasting all kinds of things!

records.jp: 食べもののこと？
records.en_original: You mean food?
records.en: You mean food?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Bingo.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 焼き芋とか
records.en_original: Like roasted yams.
records.en: Like roasted yams.

records.jp: 今、夏だよ？
records.en_original: I don't think those are in season.
records.en: I don't think those are in season.

records.jp: 季節の先取りがお洒落の基本よ
records.en_original: That just makes us trendsetters, Hinako!
records.en: That just makes us trendsetters, Hinako!

records.jp: 私は美味しい時に美味しいものを食べたいかな。<CR>旬って大事
records.en_original: I'd rather eat things when they're at their tastiest. Seasons are there for a reason, you know?
records.en: I'd rather eat things when they're at their tastiest. Seasons are there for a reason,<CR>you know?

records.jp: スルメイカとか。<CR>炙って七味マヨ。間違いないっしょ
records.en_original: How 'bout some squid? Roast it, add some spicy mayo. That's what I'm talking about.
records.en: Dried squid, for example.<CR>Grill it and add shichimi mayonnaise. You cannot go wrong.

records.jp: 私、スルメイカ食べたことないんだけど、<CR>普通の学生は食べるものなの？
records.en_original: I've never tried roasted squid before. Isn't that more of an old man food?
records.en: I have never eaten dried squid.<CR>Is that something ordinary students eat?

records.jp: 食べる食べる。休み時間とか教卓に置いてたら<CR>秒でなくなるよ
records.en_original: No way! Everyone brings it in to snack on during class.
records.en: Of course. If you put it on the teacher's desk during break,<CR>it would disappear in seconds.

records.jp: そうなんだ。挑戦してみようかな
records.en_original: Really? I guess I should try some.
records.en: Really? I guess I should try some.

records.jp: （冗談っていつバラそう）
records.en_original: (Wonder when she'll realize I'm messing with her...)
records.en: (When should I tell her I was joking?)

records.jp: とは言っても、サツマイモもスルメイカもないから<CR>適当なものを焼くしかないのです
records.en_original: Anyhow, we don't have yams or squid, so we'll have to make do with other things.
records.en: Anyhow, we don't have yams or squid, so we'll have<CR>to make do with other things.

records.jp: 焼くだけで食べられるものがあるの、ほんと助かった
records.en_original: Good thing we had some things you can eat just by roasting them.
records.en: Good thing we had some things you can eat just by roasting them.

records.jp: はー、食べ過ぎちゃった
records.en_original: Phew... I ate way too much.
records.en: Phew... I ate way too much.

records.jp: 何食べてもやたら美味しく感じるよね
records.en_original: I feel like everything tasted even better than usual.
records.en: I feel like everything tasted even better than usual.

records.jp: なんでだろう。<CR>普段食べてるものと、大した差はないはずなのに
records.en_original: I wonder why. It's not like we're eating anything different from what we usually eat.
records.en: I wonder why.<CR>It's not like we're eating anything different from what we usually eat.

records.jp: 外だからじゃない？　非日常感
records.en_original: Maybe it's because we're outside? You know, it's something new.
records.en: Maybe it's because we're outside? You know, it's something new.

records.jp: それを言いだしたら、この世界自体が<CR>非日常だと思うんだけど
records.en_original: This whole world is something new.
records.en: This whole world is<CR>something new.

records.jp: それもそっか
records.en_original: That's true.
records.en: That's true.

records.jp: でも、私にとってはこうやって人と<CR>食べること自体がまだ非日常なのかも
records.en_original: For me, just eating with another person like this is pretty unusual.
records.en: But for me, simply eating with someone like this<CR>may still be something out of the ordinary.

records.jp: だいぶ変わったけど、それでも一人だった期間の方が<CR>長いわけで。だから、特別に美味しく感じるのかも
records.en_original: Things are different now, but I was alone for most of my life. I think that may be why it tastes so good to me.
records.en: A great deal has changed, but I still spent longer alone.<CR>Perhaps that is why it tastes especially good.

records.jp: （うう、慣れてほしいけど、慣れてほしくないような）
records.en_original: (Aww... I want her to get used to this, but also kinda don't...)
records.en: (I want her to get used to it... but part of me does not.)

records.jp: 自分で作ったからじゃない？
records.en_original: Maybe it's 'cause we made it ourselves?
records.en: Maybe it's 'cause we made it ourselves?

records.jp: そっか、そんな単純なことだったんだ
records.en_original: Huh, I guess it is as simple as that.
records.en: Huh, I guess it is as simple as that.

records.jp: 普段のご飯も料理班に任せきりじゃなくて、<CR>たまには自分で作ろうかな
records.en_original: Maybe I should start cooking more instead of always making the others cook.
records.en: Maybe I should start cooking more instead of<CR>always making the others cook.

records.jp: 愛央も一緒に作る？
records.en_original: Want to join me?
records.en: Want to join me?

records.jp: それはめんど……いや、作る作る！
records.en_original: Ugh, that sounds awf—I mean, sure!
records.en: Ugh, that sounds awf—I mean, sure!

records.jp: 本音、漏れてるよ
records.en_original: I heard that.
records.en: I heard that.

records.jp: 林間学校もこんな感じなのかな
records.en_original: I wonder if this is what summer camp is like.
records.en: I wonder if a school camping trip is like this.

records.jp: んー、まぁ当たらずとも遠からずって感じ？
records.en_original: Hmm... Maybe not too far off?
records.en: Hmm... Maybe not too far off?

records.jp: ちょっとだけね、思っちゃったんだ。<CR>こんなに楽しいなら行っておけばよかったかなって
records.en_original: I was just thinking... If I knew summer camp was this much fun, maybe I would have gone.
records.en: For just a moment, I thought...<CR>If it was this much fun, perhaps I should have gone.

records.jp: どうせバレエできなくなるなら、<CR>コンクール受ける意味なかったわけだし
records.en_original: Now that I can't dance anymore, it feels like all of those competitions were for nothing.
records.en: If I was going to become unable to dance ballet anyway,<CR>then there was no point in entering that competition.

records.jp: こうやって楽しいことを覚えると、<CR>今まで捨ててきたもののことを考えちゃって
records.en_original: Doing all these fun activities with everyone makes me think about everything I gave up.
records.en: When I learn how enjoyable things like this can be,<CR>I start thinking about everything I gave up until now.

records.jp: ……あーあ、<CR>だいぶ割り切ったつもりだったんだけどなぁ
records.en_original: *Sigh* And here I thought I had come to terms with that.
records.en: *Sigh* And here<CR>I thought I had come to terms with that.

records.jp: 捨てたものって、<CR>そんな大したものじゃなかったのかもよ
records.en_original: I don't know if the things you gave up are such a big deal.
records.en: Maybe the things you gave up<CR>were not actually all that important.

records.jp: 確かに林間学校って、先生とか、そんなに仲良くない<CR>同級生とかも一緒に行くのか
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, I guess going to camp means going with people you don't necessarily like too.
records.en: Now that I think about it, I guess going to camp means going with<CR>people you don't necessarily like too.

records.jp: だったら、今日の方がよっぽどストレスなくて<CR>楽しかった……のかな？
records.en_original: That would mean what we did today is way more fun than camp.
records.en: That would mean what we did today is way<CR>more fun than camp.

records.jp: そう考えた方がよくない？
records.en_original: See? That's a way better attitude.
records.en: See? That's a way better attitude.

records.jp: ふふ、そうだね。こっちの選択肢が正解だと思おう<CR>……いや、正解なんだ
records.en_original: Hehe, you're right. I think... No, I know that I made the right choice.
records.en: Hehe, you're right. I think... No, I know that I<CR>made the right choice.

records.jp: うんうん、言いきっちゃえ！
records.en_original: Thatta girl!
records.en: Thatta girl!

records.jp: 休まなかったら、それはそれで後悔してたんじゃない？
records.en_original: Wouldn't you have regretted skipping ballet to go though?
records.en: If you had skipped the competition, would you not have regretted that too?

records.jp: ……うん。<CR>愛央にはバレバレだね、私の性格
records.en_original: Definitely. You really know me, don't you?
records.en: Definitely.<CR>You really know me, don't you?

records.jp: どうせ思い出になるなら、その時楽しかったことを<CR>全力で頑張ったって思い出の方がいいよね
records.en_original: I'd rather remember my time as being fun. I want to be able to say that I tried my best.
records.en: If it is going to become a memory either way, I would rather remember<CR>that I gave everything to what I enjoyed at the time.

records.jp: 愛央。<CR>私、手持ち花火もしたい！
records.en_original: Ao. Let's do some sparklers!
records.en: Ao. Let's<CR>do some sparklers!

records.jp: （日菜子さん、元気になったみたいでよかった）
records.en_original: (I'm glad Hinako's perked up.)
records.en: (I'm glad Hinako-san's perked up.)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
